row: Dr. Eschbach is the the most sought after Animal Chiropractic lecturer in the world. A Chiropractor from St. Louis, Missouri, he now co-owns Options for Animals College of Animal Chiropractic which is the "Gold Standard" in Animal Chiropractic Education.  His expertise is in Biomechanics, and he has shared this knowledge with thousands of doctors and animal enthusiasts on six continents.  He and his wife Debbie also share their love of Afghan Hounds and Chinese Cresteds with all that are interested.  For more information, see www.animalchiro.com.
